entries.subtopic: Usual interstitial pneumonia pattern and profibrotic signaling
entries.learning_objective: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis shows a UIP pattern with basal subpleural honeycombing, patchy temporal heterogeneity, and fibroblastic foci; TGF-beta is a central mediator of fibroblast-to-myofibroblast activation and matrix deposition.
entries.media_requirement: Original paired schematic of lower-lobe subpleural honeycombing, patchy fibrosis, fibroblastic foci, and TGF-beta signaling.

entries.subtopic: Proliferative phase, GLUT1 phenotype, and beta-adrenergic blockade
entries.learning_objective: Propranolol treats problematic infantile hemangiomas through beta-adrenergic blockade, causing early vasoconstriction and reducing proangiogenic endothelial signaling and proliferation.
entries.media_requirement: Original diagram showing infantile hemangioma proliferation, beta-adrenergic blockade, early vasoconstriction, and later involution.

entries.subtopic: E7-mediated RB inactivation and p16 overexpression
entries.learning_objective: HPV E7 inactivates RB in HPV-driven oropharyngeal carcinoma, releasing E2F and producing compensatory p16 overexpression; p16 is therefore a useful surrogate marker in the appropriate anatomic setting.
entries.media_requirement: Original pathway showing HPV E7 binding RB, E2F release, and compensatory p16 overexpression in oropharyngeal carcinoma.

entries.subtopic: Fetal bladder outlet obstruction and renal dysplasia
entries.learning_objective: Posterior urethral valves are obstructing folds in the male posterior urethra that cause fetal bladder outlet obstruction, a thick-walled enlarged bladder, keyhole dilation, hydroureteronephrosis, and potentially renal dysplasia and oligohydramnios.
entries.media_requirement: Original sagittal urinary-tract schematic showing posterior urethral valve obstruction, keyhole dilation, bladder hypertrophy, and bilateral hydroureteronephrosis.

entries.subtopic: Hapten sensitization and delayed type IV effector response
entries.learning_objective: Allergic contact dermatitis is a delayed type IV hypersensitivity reaction in which haptens modify host proteins, dendritic cells prime T cells, and memory T cells mediate inflammation on re-exposure.
entries.media_requirement: Original skin schematic showing hapten binding, dendritic-cell sensitization, and delayed T-cell effector inflammation after re-exposure.

entries.subtopic: Breslow thickness and vertical invasion
entries.learning_objective: Breslow thickness measures melanoma depth from the granular layer to the deepest invasive cell and is a major determinant of staging, metastatic risk, and prognosis.
entries.media_requirement: Original histology schematic demonstrating Breslow thickness measurement from the granular layer to the deepest invasive melanoma cell.

entries.subtopic: Generalized proximal-tubule solute wasting
entries.learning_objective: Fanconi syndrome reflects generalized proximal-tubule failure, causing urinary loss of glucose, amino acids, phosphate, bicarbonate, urate, and low-molecular-weight proteins.
entries.media_requirement: Original nephron schematic highlighting generalized proximal reabsorptive failure and loss of bicarbonate, glucose, amino acids, and phosphate.

entries.subtopic: Metaphyseal malignant osteoid production
entries.learning_objective: Osteosarcoma is diagnosed when malignant mesenchymal cells directly produce osteoid; it usually affects the metaphysis of long bones in adolescents and often shows aggressive periosteal reactions.
entries.media_requirement: Original paired radiograph and histology schematic showing metaphyseal sunburst reaction, Codman triangle, and malignant osteoid.

entries.subtopic: Reactive CD8 T-cell expansion against infected B cells
entries.learning_objective: The atypical lymphocytes of EBV infectious mononucleosis are activated cytotoxic CD8 T cells responding to EBV-infected B cells.
entries.media_requirement: Original diagram showing EBV infection of CD21-positive B cells and expansion of atypical activated CD8 T lymphocytes.

entries.subtopic: HHV-8-associated spindle-cell angioproliferation
entries.learning_objective: Kaposi sarcoma is caused by HHV-8 infection of endothelial-lineage spindle cells and is promoted by immune dysregulation and angiogenic cytokine signaling.
entries.media_requirement: Original histology and pathway schematic showing HHV-8-positive spindle cells, slit-like vessels, erythrocyte extravasation, and angiogenic signaling.

entries.subtopic: Articular-cartilage matrix degradation and subchondral remodeling
entries.learning_objective: Osteoarthritis reflects mechanically and biologically driven chondrocyte catabolism, with MMP and ADAMTS activity degrading type II collagen and aggrecan while subchondral sclerosis and osteophytes develop.
entries.media_requirement: Original joint cross-section showing cartilage fissuring, joint-space loss, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis, and catabolic enzyme activity.

entries.subtopic: UV-induced epidermal atypia and progression to squamous cell carcinoma
entries.learning_objective: Actinic keratosis is a UV-induced intraepidermal keratinocytic neoplasm that can progress to invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
entries.media_requirement: Original skin schematic showing lower-epidermal keratinocyte atypia, parakeratosis, intact basement membrane, and possible progression to invasive SCC.

entries.subtopic: Mite burrows and delayed hypersensitivity pruritus
entries.learning_objective: Scabies causes burrows in the stratum corneum, and its pruritic eruption is largely a delayed hypersensitivity response to mites, eggs, and fecal antigens.
entries.media_requirement: Original epidermal schematic showing a scabies mite burrow with eggs and fecal pellets plus a delayed T-cell inflammatory response.

entries.subtopic: Resorption of distal alveolar gas after airway occlusion
entries.learning_objective: Obstructive or resorptive atelectasis occurs when distal gas is absorbed after airway occlusion, producing focal volume loss and mediastinal displacement toward the affected side.
entries.media_requirement: Original chest schematic showing a mucus plug, distal gas resorption, lobar volume loss, elevated diaphragm, and ipsilateral mediastinal shift.

entries.subtopic: Fibroproliferation beyond wound margins and collagen accumulation
entries.learning_objective: Keloids are excessive fibroproliferative scars that grow beyond wound margins and contain abundant collagen, with type III prominent early and type I prominent in mature lesions.
entries.media_requirement: Original comparison of normal scar, hypertrophic scar, and keloid extending beyond the wound with early type III and later type I collagen.

entries.subtopic: C5-C6 Erb-Duchenne palsy
entries.learning_objective: Erb-Duchenne palsy is an upper-trunk C5-C6 lesion causing loss of shoulder abduction/external rotation and elbow flexion/supination with preserved hand grasp.
entries.media_requirement: Original brachial-plexus schematic highlighting C5-C6 upper-trunk injury and the resulting waiter’s-tip posture.

entries.subtopic: SERPINA1 Z-protein polymerization, hepatocyte retention, and elastase injury
entries.learning_objective: Alpha-1 antitrypsin Z protein polymerizes in hepatocyte ER, causing toxic gain-of-function liver disease, while low serum inhibitor levels permit neutrophil-elastase-mediated basal panacinar emphysema.
entries.media_requirement: Original diagram showing Z alpha-1 antitrypsin polymer retention in hepatocyte ER and reduced circulating protection against neutrophil elastase in basal lung acini.

entries.subtopic: Enteric hyperoxaluria and calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis
entries.learning_objective: Fat malabsorption after ileal disease or resection causes fatty acids to bind calcium, leaving free oxalate available for colonic absorption and producing enteric hyperoxaluria with calcium oxalate stones.
entries.media_requirement: Original gut-kidney schematic showing fatty acids binding calcium, increased free oxalate absorption in the colon, and urinary calcium oxalate crystallization.

entries.subtopic: Optic-chiasm compression of crossing nasal retinal fibers
entries.learning_objective: Suprasellar pituitary masses classically compress crossing nasal retinal fibers in the optic chiasm, causing bitemporal visual-field loss.
entries.media_requirement: Original sellar and visual-pathway schematic showing a pituitary macroadenoma compressing crossing nasal retinal fibers at the optic chiasm.

entries.subtopic: Enzymatic fat necrosis, saponification, and hypocalcemia
entries.learning_objective: Acute pancreatitis causes enzymatic fat necrosis; released free fatty acids bind calcium and form insoluble soaps, producing saponification and potentially hypocalcemia.
entries.media_requirement: Original diagram showing pancreatic lipase-mediated fat necrosis, free fatty acids binding calcium, soap formation, and decreased serum calcium.
